worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.summary: Pounce low with your whole flame-covered body, then skid along the ground a short way: the more you outweigh the target, the harder it presses and the more likely it sets the target ablaze. Every foe on the skid path is pressed once and shoved outward; the fire trace follows the actual skid and dies out quickly once you stop. The scorching form skids further and ignites more; the diving form is shorter and heavier.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.use.0: Crush a lighter target under your weight and press the fire in
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.use.1: Press across a small line of foes
While skidding along the ground, every enemy within a %2$s block radius of your body is pressed once for about %1$s contact damage and shoved outward; the more you outweigh a target, the harder it hits.

A pressed target has a %1$s chance to catch fire and burn for about %2$s s: while burning its physical damage is halved and it loses about 6.25%% of its maximum health every 5 seconds (at least 1); on impact it is also set alight for about %3$s s. Fire-type or burn-immune targets cannot be lit, but still take the press damage.
The low pounce touches down after about %1$s s, then skids up to %2$s blocks along the ground at %3$s blocks per tick and shoves targets %4$s blocks; a wall or a ledge ends the skid.
The skid leaves a fire trace that dies out quickly once you stop; it is only a visual, dealing no damage and changing no blocks.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.scorch.on: Scorching form: a longer skid, a wider and longer fire trace, a higher ignite chance and a longer burn, at the cost of slightly less power and a slower cast and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.scorch.off: Diving form: a shorter, heavier low pounce with a short skid and a small fire trace, but a quicker cast.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.timing: Pounce within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.growth.0: At level %1$s, the slam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.growth.1: At level %1$s, the slam power rises to %2$s and the skid to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.preference.s: On: a longer skid, a wider and longer fire trace, a higher ignite chance and a longer burn, but slightly less power and a slower cast and cooldown. Off (diving form): a shorter, heavier low pounce with a short skid and a small fire trace, but a quicker cast.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.preference.a: Only pounce once a foe is within this distance. Larger values pounce from further away, but the skid is easier to sidestep.
On: it will not press a target already burning, saving the ignite for those it can still set alight. Off: it presses regardless.
It only opens with Heat Crash when its own weight is at least this many times the target's; 0 means always. Raise it to press only when clearly heavier.
